name: Cheap Prop Controller scene image
compatibility: Project JSON remains version1. Firmware0.6.0 accepts CPC1 and CPC2. Emit CPC1 byte-for-byte unless timers, feedback, OFF intervals, release edges, alternate destinations or audioEndStateId are used. Those require CPC2 and sceneControls:true before BEGIN. ZN extension versions and record sizes are unchanged. Detailed runtime/serial contract: scene-controls-contract.json.

crc.coverage: Entire declared image, treating bytes 6 and 7 as zero

fields.0: magic: ASCII CPC1 or CPC2 (4 bytes)
fields.16: audioFlags:u8 (bit0 keepAmbient, bit1 fade-through, bits2..6 ambientMixVolume 0..30, bit7 distance-zone extension)
fields.17: fadeTicks:u8 (fade-in ticks when bit1, otherwise crossfade ticks; zero for cut)

fields.3: flags:u8 bit0 activeLow, bit1 pullup; timer bit0 resetOnExternal only
CPC1 zero; CPC2 zero disables feedback, else (busyPin+1) | (activeLow?0:128)

fields.13: CPC1 zero; CPC2 audioEndTargetIndex+1, zero none

fields.0: bits0..2 triggerIndex; bit7 release (CPC2), other bits zero

transition.groups: CPC2 repeats the same trigger/edge contiguously for round-robin targets, all unique. Max16 groups/state,8 destinations/group,128 expanded records total. A key cannot reappear in another group of that state.

fields.1: target:u8 state index for state, ambient=0/foreground=1 for volume, command index for IR
fields.2: value:u16 zero for state/IR, 0..30 for volume
fields.4: fadeTicks:u16 zero for state/IR, 0..255 for volume

irDescriptor.position: Immediately before the common last-eight-byte ZN footer for extension version 2

fields.4: payloadA:u16 NEC low16 or raw pulse start index
fields.6: payloadB:u16 NEC high16 or raw pulse count

fields.2: atTick:u16 strictly less than state duration

irExtension: Version 2 retains the common last8 ZN footer (version byte at imageLength-6) and allows zero zones. Its descriptor is the preceding8 bytes. After normal transitions: zones10*N, zoneActions6*A, timedIR4*T, commandDirectory12*C, rawPulseBytesR, descriptor8, commonFooter8. Timed IR is sorted by state then tick, stable for equal ticks. Raw command spans are contiguous in command order, each odd5..127 pulses beginning/ending with a mark, each byte2..255 in50us ticks, at most200ms total per frame. NEC payload is the full32bit frame sent LSB first, canonical50us-quantized envelope. IR zone action kind2 uses target=commandIndex and zero value/fade. All geometry, limits, pins, references and waveforms are checked before execution. Names and stable project IDs remain JSON-only.
layout: Header, all outputs, all triggers, all players, all states, each state's events in state order, each state's transitions in state order. If bit7 is set, append the extension: version 1 is zones, actions, fixed 8-byte footer; version 2 follows irExtension. Zones are ordered by physical sensor index and user order; action spans are contiguous, on-enter then on-exit per zone. Footer transitionEnd must match the end of all state transitions. Offsets must equal this packed layout. Events sorted by startTick then outputIndex. No overlapping intervals on the same output within a state. Scenes without active zones or enabled IR have no extension and retain their old bytes.
semantics: Firmware0.6.0 adds sceneControls:true, outputTest:true and audioFeedback:true. CPC2 requires sceneControls before BEGIN. Firmware validates CPC1 reserved fields as before; CPC2 permits only defined new bits. Magic-last upload must preserve the submitted version byte through virtual validation and COMMIT.

Timers are kind3 with both pins255, period1..65535 ticks, resetOnExternal bit0, zero bytes6/7. RUN/RESET starts all timer clocks; state entries do not restart them. Emit one expiration per elapsed interval, skipping catch-up bursts. Physical activation, confirmed zone entry (not baseline), and serial TRIGGER reset enabled timers; release and timer expiration do not. Reset wins on a coincident deadline. STOP halts timers.

CPC2 transitions group contiguous equal trigger/edge records; destinations are distinct. Choose the next destination on each match, maintain cursor per state/group across entries, reset cursors on RUN/RESET. Activation/release/due-timer masks share ordered first-match dispatch, then zone actions run. Audio-finished dispatch is last and suppressed if any earlier action entered a state in that pass, including same-state restart. Release requires inactive baseline followed by confirmed activation; held-at-start first release is suppressed. Timers and zoned sensors cannot use release edges.

Optional player BUSY is byte3 low7=(pin+1), highbit=activeHigh; zero disables. Only Nano/ProMini may use analog-only20/21 for this role. Distinct input claims follow audio pairs and precede triggers/outputs. Sampling avoids active sonar measurements. PLAY completion on the UART transport arms a fresh feedback epoch; active then inactive must each be stable100ms. No active signal in5s is failed, not finished. STOP/state-entry clears old completion. STATUS players contains index,feedback(disabled/stopped/starting/playing/finished/failed),busy(boolean|null). BUSY cannot identify track content or prove audible sound.

State audioEndTargetIndex+1 requires a noninitial state, nonzero nonlooping foreground, and enabled feedback on every player. Only completion of its current foreground routes to that target; ambient and retiring voices are ignored. Omitted/zero retains state on finish. Preview may infer known clip duration or inject a finish; it does not emulate physical BUSY timing.

TESTBEGIN length crc atomically checks the valid stored scene identity before disarming/stopping audio and clearing outputs. Reject during upload or IR training. TEST unsigned32mask replaces all logical output levels, rejects out-of-range bits, and renews a1500ms lease; mask0 clears outputs without exiting. Host sends desired mask every500ms. STOP, disconnect, focus/panel/project change, or lease expiration ends test and leaves stopped. RUN/RESET/TRIGGER, scene uploads and IR operations are rejected until exit. Never writes EEPROM. Generation cancellation prevents stale queued masks after STOP/disconnect. STATUS includes testingOutputs. Protocol version remains1.

Firmware 0.2.0 adds audioFadeThrough:true to HELLO/STATUS. Before BEGIN, desktop clients must check this capability when audioFlags bit1 is set. Older images remain valid. Old firmware rejects the new flag; the desktop preflight avoids invalidating an old saved scene with an unsupported upload.

Firmware 0.3.0 adds audioAmbientMix:true to HELLO/STATUS. Nonzero ambientMixVolume requires this capability before BEGIN, keepAmbient, and an ambient track. Encoded 31 is invalid; bit7 is invalid on firmware before 0.4.0. Optional project audio.ambientMixVolume defaults to zero; the compiler emits zero when keepAmbient is disabled or no ambient track is selected. Older images remain byte-for-byte compatible, with no extra scene storage for ambient mixing.

Firmware 0.4.0 adds distanceZones:true to HELLO/STATUS. Desktop requires it before BEGIN for version 1, or version 2 with nonzero zone count. A valid extension is mandatory for bit7; bounds, counts, exact packed layout, action references, sensor kinds and nonoverlapping inclusive ranges are validated before execution. Project triggers opt in with distanceMode=zones; omitted/threshold mode retains legacy behavior and inactive presets are not compiled.

Zones share one physical sensor's pins. A first fresh valid distance after startup/RESET/RUN silently establishes the baseline zone. A current zone is retained while minCm-hysteresis <= distance <= maxCm+hysteresis; otherwise choose a nominal inclusive zone or none. A stable new candidate requires fresh valid samples spanning the sensor debounce interval. Invalid/no echo/below2/above400 readings preserve current zone and cancel the candidate. Skipped intermediate ranges do not fire. Normal state entry does not rearm zones; STOP cancels pending zone activity.

Zone dispatch occurs after legacy rising-edge transitions and in physical sensor order. A confirmed change executes old exit actions then new enter actions in listed order. Each state action enters immediately, so later volume actions apply to that destination. Zoned sensors do not produce legacy rising masks, and serial TRIGGER injection is rejected for them. Per-state mappings may remain stored for switching back to threshold mode.

A volume action adjusts the currently playing or pending logical ambient/foreground role, using its own fade duration. It does not start an absent role or restart a track; zero volume preserves playback position. Retiring crossfade voices continue their original fade rather than being raised by a new action. Pending foreground fades use the override on handoff. State entry restores configured levels. IR actions require extension2; continuous distance mapping is not encoded.

Firmware0.5.0 advertises irLearning:true and irReplay:true. Desktop requires irReplay before BEGIN for extension2; distanceZones is additionally required when zoneCount>0. Old noIR images retain noextension or version1 bytes. Enabling IR reserves RX D2 and Timer1 OC1A TX (D9 on328P,D11Mega) exclusively before other roles. Timer0/Timer2 use is unchanged.

IRLEARN requires an uploaded IR-enabled scene, disarms/stops runtime, drains audio stop commands, and captures one complete frame with a10second deadline. Final response is {type:ir-capture,pulsesUs:[...]}; no early ACK. Invalid/overflow/repeat-only/timeout returns error. STOP cancels capture and clears staging; learning never implicitly arms the scene. Capture only measures the demodulated envelope;38kHz is assumed.

IRBEGIN kind pulseCount sendCount gapMs code stages a test in RAM, never EEPROM, with the same uploadedIR requirement and disarming. NEC kind0 has count0 and fulluint32 code; rawkind1 has odd5..127count and code0. IRDATA offset hex sends contiguous raw50us tick bytes, up to32 per request; ACK.offset is next offset. IRPLAY validates complete staging and acknowledges acceptance for transmission. STOP/disconnect cancels host operations; no test acknowledgement proves physical reception.

Timed IR cues fire once on crossed50ms ticks, including zero on state entry; loops repeat. Equal-time cues follow stored order, and zone actions follow their existing ordered dispatch. Eight queued commands are allowed; overflow reports an error. A state change discards obsolete queued cues but may let the active frame finish. STOP immediately forces IR off and clears queue/capture. Each command emits sendCount complete frames, with gapMs after every frame including between commands. Audio packets and active sonar measurements finish before IR begins; IR must not block USB STOP or the scene loop.

Fade-through uses one player, or two if persistent ambient and foreground are both configured. On a state change, outgoing foreground audio fades to zero using byte19 ticks; the latest requested state's foreground then starts and fades in using byte17 ticks. Foreground tracks do not overlap, and actual modules add command/decoder latency. Legacy zero-level persistent ambient fades to silence and keeps its playhead muted, then fades back in when returning to an ambient-only state. Nonzero mixed ambient remains running independently: on each state entry it moves to ambientMixVolume over fade-out ticks if the destination has foreground, or normal ambientVolume over fade-in ticks otherwise. Ambient never blocks the foreground fade-through switch. A new trigger while fading out changes the pending destination without extending the foreground fade-out deadline. STOP cancels pending audio starts immediately. Output/state timelines start on the trigger, without waiting for audio fades.

All pins are numeric Arduino IDs; Uno/Nano/ProMini A0..A5=14..19, Mega A0..A15=54..69. D0,D1 always reserved for host serial. Nano/ProMini A6,A7=20,21 are analog-only BUSY inputs in CPC2, never outputs or other digital roles.

Each pin can have exactly one role. Custom AVR players use distinct valid pin pairs. Mega players use Serial1 TX18/RX19 then Serial2 TX16/RX17 then Serial3 TX14/RX15. Relay-shield first four outputs must use D7,D6,D5,D4.

State entry resets timeline elapsed to zero. Outputs take idleActive outside intervals; within an interval logical active=true for byte5=0, false for CPC2 byte5=1. Physical high is logical active XOR activeLow. When not looping, events stop at duration and idle levels persist until transition. Looping wraps elapsed by duration.

STOP deactivates every output regardless of idleActive and stops audio. RESET/RUN resumes the initial state and its configured idleActive output levels. Every foreground state entry restarts the chosen foreground track; a retained ambient track preserves playback position.

Initial state is the ambient/idle state; entering it stops foreground and restores ambient. Any state with no foregroundTrack restores normal ambientVolume. Persistent ambient requires its own player when foreground exists and remains running at ambientMixVolume during foreground playback (zero means silent), preserving its position. Crossfade uses the configured crossfade duration for ambient level changes; cut applies them immediately. Returning to idle restores normal ambient volume even if the mixed level is higher. Natural foreground completion changes state only with a configured CPC2 audio-end target and confirmed BUSY feedback. Track numbers 1..255 map to folder /01 and filenames 001.mp3..255.mp3 (optional filename suffix after the three digits). Both player protocols use command 0x0F parameter 0x0100|track.

Triggers fire on debounced inactive-to-active edges; ultrasonic active at <=threshold, releases >=threshold+hysteresis. Invalid/no-echo threshold readings hold previous valid input state. Inputs must first be observed inactive after startup. Held sensors never retrigger on state entry. CPC2 can additionally route confirmed release edges.

For simultaneous input edges/timers, first matching transition group in current state's ordered transition list wins; only one such group per tick before zone actions. Editor may order reset transition first. Transition to current state restarts it. Reset command always enters initial state.
Duration, event boundaries, debounce and fade are multiples of 50ms. Scene engine checks stop/reset independently of timeline advancement.

EEPROM upload must invalidate magic before modifying payload and write valid magic last after complete image CRC/validation. Incomplete image never runs. No transactional second scene bank is required.
